notes: Perth Mint and Ainslie are the main bullion dealers; prices quoted per oz/gram vs AUD spot. Investment bars are sold without GST (non-Australian coins such as Krugerrand carry GST); 10% GST on jewellery is the standard rate (ATO page not reachable). Perth Mint pays about 23% below spot-equivalent for hallmarked jewellery across 9-24K (refiner rate, not shop rate). Making charges not sourced.
